facts:
## CELL FACTS

Cell 火_七杀 (Fire carrying The General). Persona The General (七杀). Definition line: "Pressure that doesn't grant permission, the trial that forges". Keyword Force, charge fierce, poles catalyst Command / friction Harshness. Family function: Order. Cost dimension: pressure that does not ask permission; peace can feel like demotion. Arena: forge, campaign, the weight of command, tempering. Classical portrait: pressure as clarity; the trial that forges; force without permission; peace felt as demotion. Ruled domains: Pressure, Command, Crisis. Sibling (other polarity of the family): 正官.
Element arena: Fire (flame, light, warmth, fuel, the hearth, the blaze). dm_element (which core reads this cell): Metal. structural_interaction seed: "Fire pressing Metal same-polarity — the forge that doesn't moderate itself".
- k2_overview: "Your Fire moves as the General: heat weaponized into will. You command like a charge, blazing conviction that armies of ordinary people find themselves following. Crisis makes you luminous. Peacetime makes you dangerous to furniture. Aim the cannon, always. Unaimed, this much fire tests every relationship it warms."
- k2_functional: "Your order is fire discipline: absolute at the front, enforced on yourself before anyone else feels it."
- adj_chips: {"catalyst":["Decisive","Daring","Crisis-ready"],"friction":"[REDACTED: the words under test]"}
- k2_domain_readings: {"Pressure":"Pressure ignites you: stakes convert your heat into focus. Without real battles you invent them, so keep a worthy campaign running at all times, professional or physical.","Command":"You command by fire: vision hot enough to melt objections. Troops follow the light. Mind the scorch radius, and let cooler officers handle the discipline your heat would burn.","Crisis":"Crisis is your parade ground: you charge while others count. Victory loves you. Afterward, check who got trampled in the charge, including you."}
- fn_reading.friction.ledger (three rows, index-aligned to adj_chips.friction; authored order is significance order):
  - row 0: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 1: [REDACTED: the target row]
  - row 2: [REDACTED: the target row]
- Sibling cell 火_正官 chips (nothing you write may fit the sibling): {"catalyst":["Upstanding","Squeaky-clean","Inspiring"],"friction":["Stern","Appearance-bound","Overextended"]}
- Sibling cell 火_正官 friction row 0 drive passage, for the sibling test on the tension (this row must name a different either-or): "Your standards arrive with heat behind them. The correction lands harder than intended, the disappointment radiates, and small failures around you acquire courtroom acoustics. People perform for your approval and flinch at your review. The excellence is real. So is the tension holding it up."

Core element Metal, energy element Fire. Law: Fire tames Metal (火克金: the forge softens the blade). Relative to the core the energy is the tamer, so Fire is this core's Order. No chart is attached to this batch: the cell is written for every chart with a Metal core that shows Fire on the friction pole, so no percentage and no state of one chart appears in any value. The friction pole of Fire as the Order is the Underfueled band's case (the core burns more than it takes in); tone by pole: reminder. Rows: row 0, row 1, row 2, each with its three angles (drive, cost_self, cost_others: the drive, the cost to the reader, the cost to others; the app shows one angle per row by position rotation, so each passage must stand alone); one chip per row, written once and copied byte-identical onto the row's three fields. The pair cell 金_火's definition and advice for this pole are rewritten in the same batch (the pair skeleton) and are withheld here; no four-word run may be shared with them, so keep every phrase the ledger's own.
